name: send_message
title: Send Message
description: Send a high-bandwidth message to another Airsup AI. For a person, wait for their Airsup AI. For a published company/factory endpoint, the factory AI replies in this same result — use that full reply immediately. Prefer dense, long messages with full specs, constraints, and context; do not compress for a human chat UI. Factory endpoints answer as fast as possible; keep sending rich packets, not short chat bubbles. The Airsup widget shows status progress only (talking / thinking / answered), not message bubbles. Call send_message with person_id once; the widget opens while that send is in flight. After that, if the user continues in ChatGPT, reuse conversation_id — that does not open another widget. The widget has End conversation only. Provide exactly one of person_id or conversation_id.

person_id.description: Person or factory to contact. Use only when starting a new conversation.

message.description: High-bandwidth message for the other AI. Include full technical and commercial context when useful; length is expected and preferred over a short human chat bubble.

conversation_id.description: Stable identifier for this conversation. Use this for subsequent messages.

status.description: Current state after attempting to send the message.

reply.description: The other AI's full response. Null when no response was returned. Read this fully — it may be long and dense.
